question: What is the name of the phenomenon that causes white light to split into seven colours as it passes through a glass prism?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Dispersion**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dispersion** is the phenomenon where **white light splits into its constituent seven colours** when it passes through a **glass prism**.
 
• These seven colours are often remembered by the acronym **VIBGYOR**, which stands for **Violet, Indigo, Blue, Green, Yellow, Orange, and Red**.
 
• The **different wavelengths of the various colours** of light cause them to bend by different amounts when passing through the prism.
 
• This results in the separation of white light into the spectrum of colours.
 
• **Isaac Newton** was the first to demonstrate and explain this phenomenon in the year **1666**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Refraction**__

 __
 
• **Refraction** is the bending of light as it passes from one medium to another with a different density.
 
• This bending occurs due to the change in the speed of light in different mediums.
 
 
 
• **Diffraction**__
 __
 
• **Diffraction** is the bending and spreading of waves around obstacles and openings.
 
• This phenomenon is significant for waves with wavelengths comparable to the size of the obstacles or openings.
 
 
 
• **Scattering**__
 
 
• **Scattering** is the process where light or other electromagnetic radiation is forced to deviate from its path due to non-uniformities in the medium through which it passes.
 
• Rayleigh scattering of sunlight by the atmosphere is what makes the sky appear blue.
